title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
description: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
description: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

title: Child's Play 2
description: While Andy's mother is admitted to a psychiatric hospital, the young boy is placed in foster care, and Chucky, determined to claim Andy's soul, is not far behind.

title: Child's Play 3
description: Chucky returns for revenge against Andy, the young boy who defeated him, and now a teenager living in a military academy.

title: Bride of Chucky
description: Animated by a vicious killer's spirit, a battered doll and its mate seek help from neighbors (Katherine Heigl, Nick Stabile) to regain human form.

title: Firestarter
description: Quasifederal agents hunt a man (David Keith), who can bend minds, and his daughter (Drew Barrymore), who can start fires by staring.

title: The Thing
description: An alien that can duplicate other life forms invades a polar research station in this remake of the 1951 classic "The Thing from Another World."

title: Darkman
description: An acid-scarred scientist (Liam Neeson) uses 99-minute masks to be with his girlfriend (Frances McDormand) and trap gangsters.

title: Tremors
description: Four big worms with multiple tongues dig high-speed around people (Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter) in the middle of nowhere.

title: Drop Dead Fred
description: An unhappy housewife (Phoebe Cates) gets a lift from the return of her imaginary childhood friend, Drop Dead Fred (Rik Mayall).

title: Howard the Duck
description: George Lucas' tale of an extraterrestrial duck who is mistakenly brought to Cleveland by an experimental laser beam.

title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
description: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

title: Kindergarten Cop 2
description: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

title: The 'Burbs
description: A suburban homeowner's vacation with his wife becomes a horror after some odd neighbors move in next door.

title: About a Boy
description: An irresponsible playboy becomes emotionally attached to a woman's12-year-old son. The man and child help each other in an unlikely friendship.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
description: A nursing-home resident (Jessica Tandy) regales a visitor (Kathy Bates) with tales of the close friendship between two women in the 1930s Alabama.

title: Sisters
description: A recently divorced woman (Amy Poehler) and her hotheaded sister (Tina Fey) throw a party that spirals out of control at their childhood home.

title: Housesitter
description: An architect (Steve Martin) has a girlfriend (Dana Delany) who won't move into his house and a dizzy woman (Goldie Hawn) who won't move out.

title: Parenthood
description: A middle-class man (Steve Martin), his wife (Mary Steenburgen), his father and a divorcee (Dianne Wiest) try to be good parents.

title: Patch Adams
description: After struggling with depression, a doctor, once a psychiatric patient, uses humor and unconventional methods in his practice.

title: Reality Bites
description: An aspiring filmmaker (Winona Ryder) follows the paths of her friends after they graduate from college in Texas.

title: The Skeleton Key
description: A woman (Kate Hudson) takes a job as a hospice nurse for a couple (Gena Rowlands, John Hurt) who live in a New Orleans house with a troublesome history.

title: The Last House on the Left
description: After their daughter is assaulted and left for dead, a couple (Tony Goldwyn, Monica Potter) take revenge on the assailants, who have taken shelter at the couple's house.

title: Snow White and the Huntsman
description: Sent by an evil queen (Charlize Theron) to capture an escaped princess (Kristen Stewart), a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) instead becomes the young woman's protector and helps her in her quest to regain control of her kingdom.

title: The Wolfman
description: A nobleman (Anthony Hopkins) contends with an ancient curse, scouring his childhood homeland for his missing brother, while a bloodthirsty beast prowls the moors.

title: The Mummy Returns
description: The mummified body of Imhotep is shipped to a museum in London, where he once again wakes and begins his campaign of rage and terror.

title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
description: After his son is tricked into awakening a cursed Chinese emperor, Rick O'Connell and his family seek a way to send the megalomaniac and his 10,000 warriors back to their graves.

title: Doom
description: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge, is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach.

title: Hellboy II: The Golden Army
description: Hellboy and his team face an underworld prince who plans to awaken a lethal army and use it to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred.

title: The Thing
description: Paranoia spreads among a team of Arctic researchers as they battle a deadly alien organism that assumes the shapes of its victims.

title: Sinister 2
description: A woman and her 9-year-old twin sons encounter the evil spirit of Bughuul in a rural house that's marked for death.

title: The Purge
